reason: Owner-authorised shared application-shell scope for the Meeting Portal: expose Meetings, Meeting Room, Participants, Resolutions, Voting, Actions and Decisions to every authenticated IRPA member/employee identity. The shared shell change must not alter any other portal's navigation, permissions, data access or workflow behaviour. Preserve authentication, authority, data-environment, Board governance, signature, invitation, finance and all existing portal-specific controls.
